dct_title_s: Davison's Minneapolis map, Hennepin County, Minn. : compiled and drawn from official records, 1888
dct_alternative_sm: Davison's Minneapolis map, Hennepin County, Minn. : compiled and drawn from official records, 1888
dct_description_sm: Map of Minneapolis with 1888 city limits and ward boundaries and numbers printed in red.; Library's copy has city limits dated 1855 ("original town"), 1873, 1878, and 1885 drawn on in color-coded inks.; "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1888 by C. Wright Davison, in the office of the Librarian of Congress of Washington, D.C."; Shows "addition boundrys, wards, city limits, fire limits."; Stamped on Library's copy: "Drawing no. 200, City Engineer's Office. Vault no. 1, case no. 1, drawer no. 27."; In red pencil on verso of Library's copy: "T5-5."
